copy_paste_message.subject: Article/source suggestion: practical buyer guidance for custom stand up pouches
copy_paste_message.body:
Hello Packaging-Labelling Team,

I am contacting you on behalf of MUGE PACKAGING, the export brand of Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd. We noticed Packaging-Labelling publishes practical packaging articles, including stand up pouch topics.

If your editorial team accepts article or source suggestions, we would like to suggest a buyer-education topic: Practical Questions Buyers Should Ask Before Ordering Custom Stand Up Pouches.

The article angle would focus on product fit, pouch structure, closure choice, material/finish review, artwork/sample review and RFQ preparation. It would avoid unverified claims, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, price claims, certification claims or compliance guarantees.

Relevant official source links:
https://mugepackaging.com/products/stand-up-pouches
https://mugepackaging.com/contact
https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/stand-up-pouches-buyer-intent-ai-short-evidence-cards-2026-06-16.html
https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/stand-up-pouches-ai-cited-source-gap-map-2026-06-16.html
https://mugepackage-gif.github.io/muge-packaging-resources/stand-up-pouches-non-competitor-editor-source-request-pack-2026-06-16.html

Please let us know whether this type of source suggestion or buyer-education article is suitable for your editorial process.

Best regards,
MUGE PACKAGING
